focus_guard.hookLine: 2:30 AM: Phir se Reels? Not again!
focus_guard.title: Reel Addiction vs. Exam Goals? #FocusGuard
focus_guard.storySummary: Arjun loses hours to doomscrolling reels every night. Priya introduces him to Aspirant Arcade's Focus Guard, which intercepts distracting apps with MCQs, helping him reclaim his study time.
